limitations: Industrial reference catalyst (Clariant) composition, Ni loading and reduction protocol undisclosed.
Single temperature (534 C) and atmospheric pressure only; no H2 co-feed, pressure or cycling tests.
800 h test is short relative to industrial catalyst life; deactivation linear or plateauing beyond 800 h is unknown.
No kinetic model or rate parameters reported.
Internal text inconsistencies: conversion after 1 h is 91.3% (p. 2) vs 90.1% (p. 4); deactivation window 550 h (p. 2) vs 496 h (p. 4); deactivation percentages not explicitly relative or absolute.
relevance: Ni catalyst long-term stability evidence for AmCraX (catalyst replacement interval assumptions in economics; ~1.5 percentage points loss over ~550 h at 534 C for industrial Ni, 13.5% loss with sintering for unpromoted Ni/Al2O3), plus a well-defined integral-PFR data point with known catalyst mass and flow (534 C, 1 atm, 0.5 g, 490 mL/min NH3) for order-of-magnitude checks of Ni kinetics, and evidence of the large heat-supply temperature approach (furnace ~680-690 C for a 534 C bed).
